Turn a study's own data fixes into candidate corrections

Source: R/correction_candidates.R
study_correction_candidates.Rd

A fix made in study code leaves the study out of step with the master and every other study (G5). This compares the study's corrected data with the study's own frozen pull, never the live view: sources are not time-travelable, so a later read would mistake upstream change for a study fix (spec §3.5).

Usage

study_correction_candidates(
  config,
  con,
  pull,
  data,
  path,
  key = c("mrn", "encounter_date"),
  dialect = "mssql"
)

Arguments

config

A master_config from read_master_config(), with sources.

con

A DBI connection to the warehouse, to read the master's lineage.

pull

Character. The study's frozen pull, from freeze_study_pull().

data

A data frame: the study's corrected data, keyed as the pull is.

path

Character. The candidate template to write, ending .csv. Never overwritten.

key

Character. The cohort unit's key columns in the pull and in data.

dialect

"mssql" or "duckdb".

Value

Invisibly, a list: candidates, inconsistent, derived (a data frame of column, n_cells), path and derived_path.

Details

  • Pass-through columns. A differing cell in a column that <master>_lineage lists becomes a row of the correction template at path. The row is keyed by the source's declared key, and expected_prior comes from the pull. evidence_type and asserted_by are left blank, so propose_corrections() refuses the file until a person has reviewed it and filled them in.

  • Derived columns. A differing cell in any other column is a candidate derivation, not a correction. It is counted per column in the -derived.csv file beside path.

  • Patient-level sources. When encounters of one patient disagree on such a source's cell, the candidates are dropped and counted as inconsistent. Agreement is checked over the encounters present in data; an encounter dropped from data carries no study value, so it cannot contradict a candidate, and intake rechecks expected_prior against the source.

  • Undeclared sources. A lineage source not declared in master.yml is counted as derived, because this intake cannot correct it.

If the source has changed since the pull, intake refuses the row as prior_mismatch. Nothing is appended here, and only counts are printed. The files hold identifiers and belong in the study's data folder.

Interim. Superseded by the HVTR registry.

See also

propose_corrections(), freeze_study_pull()

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE) &&
      requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Synthetic data; no PHI. A master, its lineage to one source, and a frozen pull.
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo", data.frame(
    mrn = c("SYN101", "SYN102"), encounter_date = as.Date(c("2010-03-01", "2011-05-02")),
    proc = "CABG", age = c(62, 70)
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_corrections_applied", data.frame(
    correction_id = character(), mrn = character(), encounter_date = as.Date(character())
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_deployment", data.frame(sql_commit = "abc1234"))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_parity", data.frame(
    sql_commit = "abc1234", verdict = "pass", verified_at = Sys.time()
  ))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "master_demo_lineage", data.frame(
    master_column = "age", source = "stg_demo", source_column = "age_years"
  ))
  study_cfg <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
  writeLines("study: st0000", study_cfg)
  q <- cohort_query("proc = 'CABG'", as.Date(c("2000-01-01", "2024-07-31")))
  pull <- pull_master(con, "master_demo", q, var_cols = c("proc", "age"),
                      path = study_cfg, dialect = "duckdb")
  published <- tempfile("published-")
  dir.create(published)
  frozen <- file.path(published, freeze_study_pull(pull, study_cfg, published,
                                                   "st0000_pull")$file)

  # The study corrects one age; that fix becomes a candidate correction to stg_demo.
  cfg_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".yml")
  writeLines(c("name: master_demo", "key: [mrn, encounter_date]", "snapshots: snaps",
               "current: x.sas7bdat", "build_program: x.sas",
               "sources:", "  stg_demo: {key: [mrn, encounter_date]}"), cfg_path)
  data <- as.data.frame(arrow::read_parquet(frozen))
  data$age[data$mrn == "SYN102"] <- 71
  out <- study_correction_candidates(read_master_config(cfg_path), con, frozen, data,
                                     tempfile(fileext = ".csv"), dialect = "duckdb")
  utils::read.csv(out$path)

  DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
  unlink(c(study_cfg, cfg_path, published, out$path, out$derived_path), recursive = TRUE)
}
